title: English Practice Quiz 0287
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
questions.explanation: Use there are with plural nouns.

questions.question: Which is a complete sentence?
questions.explanation: The team finished the work contains a subject and a complete predicate.

questions.question: He speaks English ___.
questions.explanation: Clearly is the adverb describing how he speaks.

questions.question: Choose the opposite of 'polite'.
questions.explanation: Rude is the opposite of polite.

questions.question: Someone says, 'Thank you for your help.' You reply:
questions.explanation: You're welcome is a natural response to thank you.

questions.question: Choose the correctly written date phrase.
questions.explanation: Days of the week begin with a capital letter.

questions.question: She arrived ___.
questions.explanation: Late is the correct adverb meaning not on time.

questions.question: A synonym of 'begin' is ___.
questions.explanation: Start has the same basic meaning as begin.

questions.question: You did not hear someone. You say:
questions.explanation: Could you repeat that, please? is a polite request.

questions.question: Choose the correct word: ___ going to arrive soon.
questions.explanation: They're is the contraction of they are.
